gitCommit.subject: S7a fix 1: tap-only sheet, correct Peek height, free map gestures
gitCommit.body:
S7a fix 1: tap-only sheet, correct Peek height, free map gestures

AC-06 (drag): D73 ruled the sheet drag off. RealmSheetHost passes EnableDragToSize=false and no longer passes SnapMode or subscribes to
CurrentSizeChanged (MudX only echoes the size the host gave it, so nothing it raises is a request any more); the handle button keeps the tap and the keys.
The handle CSS is a tap target (cursor pointer, touch-action manipulation). The realmShell.js tap shim and isTap go: they existed only to repair the click
that MudX's drag pointer capture swallowed, and with no capture a late shim click could only toggle twice. AC-06 loses its drag step; AC-07 now asserts
that a press that moves away from the handle resizes nothing at Peek and at 80 %; AC-08 reaches 80 % by tap; X-07 drops the handle-drag count and waits
for the wheel zoom before it counts frames. RealmSheetHostTests, SheetPartsTests and realmShell.test.mjs follow (no SnapMode, no echo-as-request, no shim).

X-14 (wheel): the test now polls for the wheel zoom instead of reading the camera once after settled(); the assertion (zoom changes by more than 0.01)
and its failure message are unchanged.

ROOT CAUSE: (1) AC-06: heightPx 667.94 at state peek is 73 % of 915, a drag in flight. MudX's own drag had set its internal size to 73 and the host kept
passing CurrentSize=19, which MudX's ParameterState never re-applies because it only reacts to a CHANGE of the parent's value; data-state comes from the
host's Size (peek), not from the measured height. The Peek measure itself is right (AC-05 is green at 174), and with EnableDragToSize=false MudX never changes
its size on its own. (2) X-14: not a scroll lock. MudBlazor's lock is the class scroll-locked(-no-padding) on <body> (overflow:hidden) and neither MudBlazor's
scroll manager nor MudX 9.5.0 registers any wheel or touch listener; the non-modal overlay is pointer-events:none (the CI annotation shows both), and the pan
in the same test passed. The wheel did nothing for the test because MapLibre's scroll-zoom handler waits 40 ms to tell a wheel from a trackpad and then
eases for about 200 ms, while settled() (map.isMoving()) is false until that timer fires, so the camera was read before it moved. Reproduced against the
S7 realmMap.js with no sheet or lock: after page.mouse.wheel the zoom is 10.846785693787368 right after settled() (the CI value to the digit), 11.249 after 600 ms.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01KBQausaArk3u4LVWi4qxwu
